messages:
mira: Quick sync — we need to finalize the enterprise compliance roadmap items for Q3. Sales has three priority asks: BYOK for EU (customer-managed KMS + escrow), configurable audit-log retention tiers (with legal-hold override), and closing SOC2 evidence-export format gaps. Can we sketch launch criteria + owners by EOD?
alex: ACK. I'll own BYOK/KMS technical acceptance criteria. Need clarity on minimum supported KMS features (importable keys, rotation hooks, attestations).
juan: From infra: region isolation + private control plane implications for EU BYOK. We need a migration plan for Dedicated -> Private customers. Also cost delta for HSM-backed vs KMS-on-cloud.
sasha: FYI — enterprise sales stack has three deals waiting. One bank requires 7yr retention + legal-hold e-discovery. They will only sign if BYOK + retention SLOs are explicit.
olivia: Legal: retention + legal-hold must support export in an unalterable format and chain-of-custody metadata. We also need an on/off toggle per-tenant for legal-hold; retention cannot be auto-deleted while hold is active.
sam: Oncall perspective: audit-log retention tiers must include read/restore runbook and a snapshot TTL. Operational acceptance = ability to surface logs to SRE within 10m for last 90d, and within 24h for archive tier.
taylor: Customer-success: we need a clear onboarding checklist for BYOK handshakes, and a small automation for key-roll emergencies (contact + rotate fallback).
alex: Draft acceptance criteria for BYOK: 1) handshake flow tested end-to-end with a test tenant, 2) key import verification + signing attestation, 3) rotation test with zero-downtime fallback, 4) escrow export in sealed envelope format, 5) audit trail of key ops immutable. Is that enough?
mira: Good start. Add SLOs: latency impact <10% for generation ops vs default keys; SLA on key ops 99.9% for dedicated customers. Also need compatibility matrix for model variants/quantization.
juan: For retention tiers, propose default 90d hot, 2y warm (searchable), 7y cold (archive). Legal-hold must pin items across tiers. Storage estimate: ~0.015 USD/GB-month hot, 0.006 USD/GB-month cold (ops rough).
sasha: Sales question: can we offer a paid add-on for extended retention before GA? Some customers will pre-buy.
olivia: Compliance checkboxes for SOC2: evidence export format must be machine-parseable + signed, include request/response, model version, and KMS fingerprint. We should list this as a must-have for control A.3.
sam: Runbook snippet for gated rollout: deploy -> smoke (ingest + read) -> BYOK handshake test -> e2e workload (2 customers) -> monitor 72h -> open to wider pilot. If any key escrow failure -> immediate rollback.
juan: Small config example for retention policy: ```yaml
retention:
  default: 90d
  warm: 730d
  archive: 2555d
  legal_hold: true
```
alex: Security checklist additions: HSM attestation, key-usage telemetry retention, rotate-without-downtime tests, and signed export format. Also confirm if our KMS integration supports import of RSA+ECDSA keys customers may request.
mira: Decision needed: prioritized order — (A) BYOK EU pilot + escrow, (B) retention tiers + legal-hold, (C) SOC2 evidence export polish. My recommendation: A first (sales urgency), B parallel with A infra work, C scheduled immediately after A pilot. Thoughts?
sasha: Agree. A unlocks three deals. B is sticky but we can offer interim manual exports for early customers.
taylor: We'll prepare onboarding docs for pilot customers if A is greenlit.
olivia: I'll draft SOC2 evidence requirements and map them to acceptance tests.
sam: I'll own the rollback/runbook and SRE acceptance.
juan: I'll size infra changes and get cost delta to product by EOD tomorrow.
alex: I'll produce a BYOK acceptance checklist and quick test harness (mock KMS) by end of week.
mira: Thanks — assign owners in the roadmap spreadsheet. Pull requests: please add owners to the ticket in the product board.
deploy-bot: release-notes: created epic "Q3-enterprise-compliance-eu-byok-retention" (epic/7832)
mira: great — will sync with sales + legal at 3pm. Short follow-ups only after that. :thumbsup:
